# Stochastic_LIF_Inference

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neuron model with stochastic firing thresholds or noise injection for probabilistic inference. Adds inherent stochasticity to neural computation, useful for uncertainty representation and energy-efficient probabilistic computing.
